[LSIG.7.3] `active_fraction < ε` as an idle / cycle-done signal is therefore
intrinsically lagged by up to `W` and is tick-driven. An author who needs a
prompt idle signal should use `onset_rate ≈ 0` or the source fact's own
retraction; `active_fraction < ε` carries "has been idle for most of the
window" semantics where the ~`W` lag is intended.
